as_told.title: Hugh Everett worked for the Pentagon on nuclear game theory

plain: Hugh Everett, the physicist who came up with the "many worlds" theory that every possible outcome of a quantum event plays out in its own universe, later went to work for the Pentagon on game theory for the US nuclear program. Michels tells this himself on two episodes, without naming a source, and on one of them he also names Everett's physicist colleagues John Wheeler and Bryce DeWitt. He raises it because it ties one of the strangest ideas in physics to the nuclear weapons establishment.
